subject: South Street Historic District Planning
overview: The Historic District Commission reviewed draft materials and established a timeline for creating the proposed South Street Historic District. Due to the lack of a quorum, no formal votes were taken.

items.title: Brochure and Website Updates
items.summary: Members discussed adding a QR code to the district brochure and updating the website with guidelines and information for the proposed South Street historic district.

items.title: South Street Historic District Preliminary Report
items.summary: The commission reviewed the draft Local Historic District report and agreed to finalize edits for submission to the Massachusetts Historical Commission by mid-July.

items.title: Public Hearing and Abutter Notification Planning
items.summary: Members planned a public hearing for September 14, 2023, at City Hall and set a target to mail notices to property owners and abutters within 300 feet in August.
